item.title: Apple Announces Low-Cost 'MacBook Neo' with A18 Pro Chip
item.description:

MyFirst Kids Watch Hacked. Access to Camera and Microphone
item.description:
📝 A KTH student hacked a children's watch – revealing serious security flaws Gustaf Blomqvist discovered a serious vulnerability in a smartwatch designed for children. Smartwatches for children have been hacked before, so Gustaf Blomqvist chose a watch that was different from those that had been hacked previously. Pontus Johnson, professor of network and systems engineering, believes that what Gustaf Blomqvist's thesis reveals is serious.
🔗 Read more: https://www.kth.se/en/om/nyheter/centrala-nyheter/kth-studenten-hackade-klocka-for-barn-1.1461249
